title: Arrow tool: rubber-band marquee selection and Shift-click multi-select
description:
The Selection/Arrow tool (V) cannot select multiple objects. Shell.tsx line ~2009 comments 'multi-select is not yet supported; select any for now.' Flash 8 core workflow:
1. Drag on empty stage draws a rubber-band rectangle; release selects all display objects that intersect or are enclosed.
2. Shift-click toggles individual objects in/out of the selection set.
3. With multiple objects selected: Transform, Align, Group, Cut, Copy all operate on the full set.

Acceptance criteria:
- Drag on empty stage draws a visible dashed selection rect.
- All display objects intersecting the rect on release are added to selectedIds.
- Shift-click adds/removes a single object from selection.
- Existing single-click selection behaviour is unchanged.
- Selection handles (bounding box) enclose the union of all selected objects.

Key files: packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx (mouse events), packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx (selectedIds state).
